scope: Google compatibility follow-up with bounded original implementation. Google Search remains unverified end to end.

baseline.recovered_030_history: The prior 0.31 release report retains the validated 0.30 recovery and 0.29 reference provenance.

constraints.automatic_http_resource_origin: Exact document scheme/host/port, including every redirect.
constraints.script_navigation_origin: Exact document scheme/host/port plus automatic request rules, including every redirect.
constraints.cookie_persistence: None: in-memory session only, exact-host scope.

static_pe_validation.validation_scope: Static PE headers, imports, VERSIONINFO and all icon/group resource bytes; executable not run.

coverage: real HTTP and DOM cookies, named form, inserted bootstrap, replacement navigation
CSP and origin refusals without forbidden sink requests
navigation and Stop cancel active and queued work
unchanged and changed hash navigation preserve pending scripts

javascript_reference.scope: Standalone interpreter against Node.js; DOM and App behavior tested separately.

clippy.scope: Standalone test crate referencing the actual cookies.rs and url.rs files

behavior.domain_scope: exact host; matching Domain attributes never broaden storage
behavior.capacity: expired entries removed; excess writes rejected atomically
behavior.output: longer paths then original creation order; skip whole entries that do not fit

cookie_module.integration_requirement: set_http only receives top-level responses or same-origin resources, including redirect hops. Caller supplies scheme+exact-host SameSite context and safe top-level navigation flag. DOM setter may ignore generic rejected-write errors.
cookie_module.scope: Cookie module verification only; not live Google Search end-to-end validation.

checks: report-only captures real resource activity, script error, and timer error
report plus source plus render is pixel-identical to render-only and preserves original HTML
source-only is headless and preserves original source, profile and history
real inserted-script navigation shares cookies and exports the final document
timer settling services real navigation and exports its final source
navigation failures save diagnostic reports and exit unsuccessfully
explicit profile is read without rewriting settings or history
report-only ignores the default profile and preserves history bytes
wait out of range is rejected
detached inspector without render is rejected
